title: Synthetic traffic-driven scheduled drill harness with SLO regression detectors and automated rollback gates
creator: Liam O'Rourke
description: Build and validate a non-disruptive, repeatable scheduled-failover drill harness that: generates synthetic request traffic mirroring production distributions, detects SLO regressions automatically, executes progressive circuit-breaker shadow tests, verifies backup/restore fidelity for KV and tokenstore, and enforces an automated rollback gate when regressions exceed safety thresholds. This ticket covers the orchestration, observability queries, acceptance gates, and a small runner that can be scheduled from the Console to execute drills against an active-passive region pair in a canary environment. The goal is to reduce manual coordination for quarterly DR drills and produce deterministic pass/fail outputs tied to our SLO definitions and error budget policy.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Drill runner can be scheduled from Console with a defined traffic profile and ramp schedule.
2) Synthetic traffic distribution approximates production p50/p95 request size and inter-arrival characteristics (validated by comparison to historical telemetry).
3) Automated SLO regression detectors run during the drill and return a pass/fail decision using preconfigured queries (p50/p95 latency and error-rate).
4) If SLO regression crosses thresholds (defined below) the harness triggers automatic rollback and records an incident stub.
5) Backup snapshot is taken and a restore verification job validates KV prefix integrity and tokenstore replay for a random subset of keys.
6) Post-drill artifact bundle (logs, metrics, snapshots, validation diffs) is uploaded to the DR run archive.
7) Runbook executes without requiring on-call intervention for at least 3 of 5 scheduled dry-runs in canary environment.
runbook_steps: Pre-drill: create DR run in Console -> select source region (active) and target region (passive-warm). Confirm model pins and reserved-capacity alignment.
Snapshot: quiesce writes for 30s, trigger incremental snapshot of KV and tokenstore; verify snapshot completion status in backup service.
Traffic stage 0 (dry smoke): route 1% synthetic traffic distribution to passive region (shadow mode) for 5 minutes to verify routing, KV read-only consistency and auth paths.
Traffic stage 1 (gradual ramp): increase synthetic traffic to 10% over 10 minutes using production-matched distribution generator; measure p50/p95 lat and error-rate.
Circuit-breaker shadow test: introduce a controlled latency injection to a non-critical path and validate CB telemetry (trips, half-open attempts) in shadow mode without affecting live traffic.
Failover pivot: when preconditions satisfied (snapshot OK, smoke pass) perform controlled traffic cutover to passive region for up to 15 minutes using progressive weight shift (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
Restore verification: run KV reconciliation job that compares checksums for sampled prefixes and rerun tokenstore replay for a selected 1k requests to validate statefulness.
SLO detector evaluation: run detector queries after each ramp step; if any threshold breached, execute automated rollback gate immediately.
Rollback: re-route traffic back to active region, reverse any in-flight migrations, mark run as 'aborted' and capture full artifact bundle.
Post-run: upload artifact bundle, auto-generate run summary, schedule postmortem if aborted or if regression > 2x allowed error budget burn for the run.
test_plan: Create canary environment pair (us-east-1 active, us-west-2 passive-warm) with mirrored model pins and a reduced token quota.
Deploy 'drill-runner' job (k8s CronJob) that accepts a JSON profile describing traffic shape, max ramp rate, and rollback gates.
Run five dry-runs with incrementally closer production shapes; collect telemetry for distribution drift analysis.
Introduce synthetic failure modes (latency injection, 503s, KV read skews) in isolation to validate detector sensitivity and false-positive rate.
Validate backup/restore by seeding deterministic test keys, taking snapshot, restoring to passive, and asserting checksums and event replay idempotence.
Conduct a 'no-op' run that exercises the whole harness but aborts before cutover to validate the artifact pipeline and post-run reporting.
monitoring_queries: SLO_p95_latency_query: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) FROM request_latency WHERE route='generation' AND model IN ('gpt-3-like') SINCE run_start
SLO_error_rate_query: SELECT rate(count(error) by status>=500) / rate(count(request)) FROM requests WHERE service='inference' SINCE run_start
CB_trip_rate_query: SELECT count(trips) FROM circuit_breaker where region=$target_region SINCE run_start
KV_checksum_mismatch_query: SELECT count(*) FROM kv_reconcile WHERE mismatch=true AND sample_run_id=$run_id
postmortem_template:
Summary: one-paragraph summary of drill intent and outcome.
Timeline: bullet list of key timestamps (start, snapshot, ramp steps, decision points, rollback if any).
SLO impact: include p50/p95 deltas and error-rate deltas with pre/post comparisons.
Root cause hypotheses: short list with confidence levels.
Action items: distinct owner, estimate, and due date.
Artifacts: links to snapshot, logs, dashboards, and uploaded validation diffs.
